ops.title: install-desk-7 handoff (Nov 8 10:30 AM)
ops.body:
install-desk-7 handoff, Nov 8 10:30 AM

State on the Mac (read):
- lr 0.1303.1, pack 0.7.2032 (supervisor runs, pins, serves it).
- long-running@skills plugin 0.7.2041 in ~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json, updated 10:24 AM (blocker 615123). capt-hook loads pack hooks from that path, not from ~/.claude/long-running/current. Until 10:24 it was stuck at 0.7.1946 since Nov 7, so hooks merged after that never fired.
- cc-slack 0.16.10, cc-present 0.60.1.

In flight:
- My script was installing lr pack 0.7.2041 to match the plugin, waiting on long-running CI for its base db51d76. If the session ended first, rerun:
  ~/.vcache/scratch/install-desk-7/install-tag.zsh db51d76 <ci-run> <ci-run>
  then post landed to meta-desk re 615123.

Scripts in ~/.vcache/scratch/install-desk-7/:
- install-tag.zsh <commit> <ci> <rel>: watches CI, then release, then picks the newest pack tag carrying the commit. It also watches CI on tag^, runs lr install, and now also updates the skills marketplace and the long-running@skills plugin, recording the plugin version. For a pack-only change, pass the CI run twice.
- slack-at.zsh / present-at.zsh <commit> <ci> <rel>: brew cask upgrade plus a plugin update under lockf. To install despite an infra-red lint, pass the release run twice.
- present-find.zsh <commit> <ci>: finds cc-present's Release run itself.

Lessons this shift:
- GitHub 503/504s hit golangci-lint downloads and release publishes repeatedly (Nov 8 2:20 to 4 AM). gh run rerun --failed fixes them, and an infra-only lint red doesn't block a cask install when every other job passed.
- When several PRs merge close together, install the newest commit once; check carriage with gh api compare A...B.
- The supervisor's step clocks charge every step of a plan to the lane named in step 1. Answer with --re <step>, saying what is done and that the rest is another lane's.
- cci --resolves is refused on report and landed records; use answer --resolves for asks.

Open, unchanged: the desk-creds and obs launchd desks run old processes, and restarting either needs the owner's word for that service (card 588617 for desk-creds). dar-desk-3 is down, so no Sprite rolls.
